The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's unsupported guess at Step 31. Its replanned fact sheet listed "$445,000 to $555,000" as an educated guess for January 2023, but those figures came from December 2024 listings on Zillow and Realtor.com that the team had already seen. No January 2023 data had been retrieved. That guess was later emitted as the final answer (445000) at Step 120, while the correct answer is 1010000.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 31
